items.name: Encore
items.tagline: Concert diary for iPhone, over 2,700 accounts
items.summary_md: Letterboxd for concerts. Log the artist, venue, photos, and videos on the way home, then get stats, a venue passport, and a year-end recap. Over 15,000 concerts logged, in four languages.

items.name: HabitDex
items.tagline: Pokémon-style habit tracker for iPhone
items.summary_md: Check-ins give your companion XP, and streaks unlock and evolve new creatures. Habit data stays on the device, with optional CloudKit sync. Designed by Miguel Ferrer ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mffdr/?locale=en)), built by me.

items.name: Audio Silence Remover
items.tagline: Mac app that cuts dead air from voiceovers
items.summary_md: Set a decibel threshold and a minimum pause, and it removes or shortens every silence, then exports a new MP3. No account or analytics, and the App Store build shares one codebase with the GitHub repository.

items.name: Musatro
items.tagline: Browser roguelike built on the card game Mus
items.summary_md: The four Mus lances with a run structure borrowed from Balatro: eight antes, 21 items, and 10 bosses. Strict TypeScript with no framework, and Vitest covers scoring and item order.

items.name: Viajante
items.tagline: Flight and hotel search for the terminal and AI agents
items.summary_md: Searches Google Flights, Google Hotels, and Booking.com from your own machine, with no API keys. Beyond plain search it finds the cheapest dates, explores destinations from an origin, checks Skiplagged hidden-city fares, and compares award points across transfer partners. Install from PyPI or npm, or run it with `uvx`.

items.name: FreshCtx
items.tagline: Keeps a coding agent's view of the code current
items.summary_md: Before each model request, it swaps old file reads in the conversation for the current code, within a token budget. The saved conversation stays intact, and the measurements live in a separate research repo.

items.name: Cue
items.tagline: On-device meeting recorder for the Mac
items.summary_md: Records the microphone and system audio together and transcribes on the device through a native Swift helper built on transcribe.cpp.

items.name: Plugin Factory
items.tagline: Turns client information into a Claude plugin
items.summary_md: Drop in any client information and get a ready-to-install Claude plugin in your workspace. It installs from its own marketplace in Claude Code and also loads in Cursor.

items.name: Underscore
items.tagline: Original music scored to your video edit
items.summary_md: Mark in and out inside the video editor, press generate, and get an original track that lasts exactly that long and changes where the video changes.

items.name: Roamly
items.tagline: Voice travel buddy for iPhone
items.summary_md: Talk to a travel buddy by voice, built on ElevenLabs Agents. Built in 2.5 hours at the ElevenLabs x Enzo Ventures Build Night in Madrid, in a team of three formed on the night, and placed second.

items.name: Automatic Farms
items.tagline: Minecraft mod that builds survival farms
items.summary_md: Place a controller, pick a blueprint, load the materials, and it builds the farm block by block. Blueprints include a mob drop tower, an iron golem farm, a creeper gunpowder chamber, and a Nether gold farm.

items.name: Triple Check
items.tagline: Spanish pop-rock band, 1.7M Spotify streams
items.summary_md: Three school friends from Burgos: me, Miguel Ferrer, and Diego Garrido. I handle production, mixing, and lyrics. No label, and several tracks have over 100,000 streams each.

items.name: Ultramar AI
items.tagline: Offline travel assistant on local models
items.summary_md: Chat, translation, and photo questions run on local Qwen and Gemma models, with Apple Intelligence as a fallback, so it works on a plane or while roaming.

items.name: SimpleIndieBudget
items.tagline: Budget tracker for indie app makers
items.summary_md: Tracks subscriptions, recurring costs, and revenue estimates for indie app makers, with CSV import.

items.name: ViralSlide
items.tagline: TikTok slideshow generator with AI hooks
items.summary_md: AI-written hooks and reusable slideshow formats, in English and Spanish. Built in two afternoons.

items.name: FancyDocuments
items.tagline: Turns plain text into designed documents
items.summary_md: Upload plain text, Word, or Markdown and get a designed document, with a live preview and credit-based pricing.

items.name: Katarite
items.tagline: Illustrated AI bedtime stories for children
items.summary_md: Personalized stories with generated images, accounts, and a subscription.

items.name: IdeasHub
items.tagline: Project docs workspace with AI drafting
items.summary_md: Structured docs for software, hardware, and service projects, with a Markdown editor and AI-drafted sections.

items.name: Kalki
items.tagline: Calorie and weight tracker for iPhone
items.summary_md: Food logging, weight charts, BMR and TDEE goals, and achievements.

items.name: ChatHerencias
items.tagline: AI assistant for Spanish inheritance law
items.summary_md: One free consultation, then paid credits through Stripe.
